content: OpenVLA-OFT uses a custom transformers fork (moojink/transformers-openvla-oft), pinned at 4.40.1 API surface but with bidirectional attention modification. The custom fork is specified in pyproject.toml as: 'transformers @ git+https://github.com/moojink/transformers-openvla-oft.git'. When loading model for Phase 1 ENV-03 smoke test, use trust_remote_code=True because the model uses custom modeling code from prismatic library embedded in the checkpoint. For inference producing a 7-D action, the full OFT workflow uses get_vla_action() which calls the model with both image and proprio state. A simpler ENV-03 check can load the model via AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained(checkpoint, trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16).to('cuda') and verify model.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and next(model.parameters()).is_cuda, avoiding full inference.
